messages.subject: paste value only
messages.body_plain:
Hello

I am using xlsx very much like this previous post (http://
groups.google.com/group/r-package-xlsx/browse_thread/thread/ <http://groups.google.com/group/r-package-xlsx/browse_thread/thread/>
bb2a95e1756899d7), i.e. I am using an Excel template to create
reports. Within R I follow these steps:

1) read the template using loadWorkbook
2) read the sheets using getSheets
3) paste data into some of those sheets using addDataFrame
4) save the result into a new Excel file using saveWorkbook

My problem is if within my template the range of cells where I want to
paste data contains specific formats (frames, background, fonts,
etc.), all those are lost after data is pasted with addDataFrame.

So my question: is there a way to preserve the formats where the data
is pasted? In Excel language, this is what people would call a "paste-
special / values".

I've thought of an alternative which would require to paste data in a
hidden tab of my template and have the pretty formated cells use
references to the hidden data, but then I am having the same problem
as the other post mentioned above. Any progress regarding this issue?

Thank you for your help,
Florent.

messages.subject: Re: Help with recalculating formulas
messages.body_plain:
Not an optimal solution, but you can do this while waiting for
Adrian's new release: as your workbook opens, force Excel to recalc
all cells via VBA code.

You can follow these steps:

1) open your template with Excel
2) press ALT+F11 to enter VBA mode
3) add a module to your project with the following code:

Sub Auto_Open()
    Application.CalculateFull
End Sub

4) save your template with the *.xlsm extension (macro enabled) and
exit
5) within R, when you save your final product in a file, also make
sure to use the *.xlsm extension.

Florent.

messages.subject_clean: version 0.4.0 of package xlsxjars has been submitted to CRAN
messages.body_plain:
This contains the version 3.8 (latest) Apache POI jars.

All the tests I had with package xlsx passed successfully with these jars.  Let me know if you see any problem.

With this version you can force workbook recalculation on loading with
wb$setForceFormulaRecalculation(TRUE)

See link below for the list of improvements
http://www.apache.org/dist/poi/release/RELEASE-NOTES.txt

Adrian
